arguments.query: small business needs help with data organization or reporting

results.text: A small workshop asks peers how they track changing supplier prices and lead times for recurring materials.
Reviews for a small retailer repeatedly disagree about available products, pickup rules, and current opening hours.

A solo professional reports spending substantial time responding to inquiries that do not match the services actually offered.

arguments.scope: Create a concise service-description filter document: a one-page client-facing FAQ/screening guide plus 5-7 qualifying questions/checklist that the solo professional can use (or paste into an auto-responder/intake form) to filter inbound inquiries against the services actually offered, reducing time spent on mismatched inquiries. Delivered as a text document.

arguments.query: local services business needing simple documentation or checklist help

results.text: A repair business has conflicting public descriptions of what its standard service includes, and customers keep asking the same questions.
Customers of a seasonal service complain that appointment availability and expected response times are unclear.
A small professional practice is publicly comparing several software subscriptions but lacks a consistent cost and feature analysis.
A small workshop asks peers how they track changing supplier prices and lead times for recurring materials.
A specialty seller has duplicated and inconsistent product descriptions across several public listings.

arguments.scope: Create a concise, single-page "Service Scope Sheet" for the repair business: a clear, authoritative summary of exactly what the standard service includes and excludes, written to resolve conflicting public descriptions and answer the most common customer questions.
